name: date-field
description: A field for entering a date value.

granularity.description: Smallest unit the field edits; hour, minute and second add time segments (Figma date-and-time).

isError.description: If there is an error, this property overrides show valid icon.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the component: sets the width and the spacing between the label, the field and the help text.

anatomy.name: field-label
anatomy.description: Text label that names the field, placed above or beside it.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Bordered box that frames the segments.

anatomy.name: segment
anatomy.description: One editable unit of the date (month, day, year), drawn as its own rounded cell and showing a placeholder when empty.

anatomy.name: error-icon
anatomy.description: Alert icon in the end container of the field, shown when isError is true.

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline drawn around the field for keyboard focus.

anatomy.name: help-text
anatomy.description: Description or error message shown below the field.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web Date and time field page (label, field with value cells, End container with AlertTriangle when invalid); RSP DateField InvalidIndicator and DateSegment. Owner decision D2 (2026-11-19): the root part container holds field-label, field and help-text. Owner decisions A9 (2026-11-20): error-icon and focus-indicator are added; the options granularity (covers Figma date-and-time), hourCycle and hideTimeZone follow RSP; the state set matches text-field. date-picker keeps its own per-host field copy. Literal separators are not a part.
